title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-03-21

ai_review.summary: Lively audience cassette capture of a late‑60s/early‑70s set with standout Not Fade Away and China Cat teases, solid sound despite some missing cuts.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience tape from the early ’70s that delivers surprisingly clear sound for an old cassette, with a lively crowd that adds intimacy. Highlights include a phat Not Fade Away jam punctuated by China Cat and Chinacat teases, plus a sweet Katie Mae, while the setlist’s vintage covers keep things fun. Minor issues such as duplicate tracks, missing songs and a truncated ending to Not Fade Away are noted but don’t ruin the overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers (5‑star) praise both performance and tape quality; a few note missing/cut portions, pulling the average down slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Solid tuning and lively crowd ambience; clear for an old cassette. Issues: duplicate tracks, missing early‑show songs, and NFA ending cut off.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Balanced set with vintage 50s/60s covers and classic Dead material; audience energy keeps momentum even when tape glitches occur.
